# Resolved install set for the TERRA Python sidecar.
#
# requirements.txt stays the declaration: floors, plus the one scikit-learn
# bound that matches the version model/*.joblib was fitted under. Floors let
# eleven of twelve packages resolve to whatever the index offers that day, so
# two machines run different code from the same manifest. The NumPy
# DeprecationWarnings the sidecar tests emit while joblib unpickles are that
# drift surfacing; pinning makes them reproducible rather than absent.
#
# Compiled --universal, so this one file serves Linux CI and macOS or Windows
# development: the entries that differ by platform carry environment markers
# and pip skips the ones that do not apply. Hashes are included, which makes
# pip refuse any artifact that does not match.
#
# Regenerate with:
#
#   uv pip compile --universal --python-version 3.12 --generate-hashes \
#     --no-header requirements.txt -o requirements.lock.txt
#
# then restore this header, which the command does not write.
